 Jennifer Lawrence Is Very Proud of Her ‘New’ Boobs
 By 
 Olivia Craighead ,
 a news writer for The Cut who covers pop culture and celebrity.   
 Previously, she wrote about pop culture and entertainment at Gawker. 
 9:44 A.M. 
 Save this article to read it later.
 Find this story in your account’s ‘Saved for Later’ section.
 Photo: John Nacion/FilmMagic 
 Jennifer Lawrence has no qualms about sharing the details of her boob job . During an appearance on Watch What Happens Live on Thursday night, the actress highlighted her “new” implants to Andy Cohen. During the episode, Lawrence played a round of “Mystery or Not to Me,” which involved Cohen asking if it was a mystery to her “how a boob could break Hailey Glassman’s nose.” ( The Real Housewives of New York star claims to have broken her nose while having sex with a woman with “big double-D tits.”)
 “Yes, and I have implants,” Lawrence answered. When Cohen expressed his shock at Lawrence’s plastic surgery, she told him that they’re “new” and pushed her chest forward to show them off. Cohen told Lawrence that her new boobs are “beautiful,” and she gave credit to “Dr. Teitelbaum in Santa Monica.” I assume she means Dr. Steven Teitelbaum, who has a private practice in Santa Monica. His website boasts that he is “internationally recognized” for his breast surgery and that he delivers “beautifully natural results that honor each patient’s unique goals, anatomy, and lifestyle.”
 Cohen, never one to shy away from a tacky question, asked Lawrence if her new breasts were B-cups. “No, it’s a full C, I think. It’s the same size that they were,” she said, referring to her body before having children. Cohen said he appreciated Lawrence’s “restraint.”
 This is hardly the first time Lawrence has spoken about going under the knife. In an October 2025 New Yorker profile, she said that she was getting her boobs done that November, inspired by the changes in her body after having her two children. “Everything bounced back, pretty much, after the first one,” she said. “Second one, nothing bounced back.” She added that if she weren’t a famous actress, she would probably still be getting the surgery, but probably wouldn’t be “hustling to the appointment in the same way.”
 In her Cut cover story last month, Lawrence confirmed that she had gotten a boob job and that one day she wants to get a face-lift. “I want to be a sexy mom,” she said. “At drop-off, I want to look like a woman that has her shit together even when I’ve just woken up and don’t have my shit together.” Shout-out to Teitelbaum for helping Lawrence achieve her goals.
